entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Fernando Intriago Páez is a secularized priest from Guayaquil, Ecuador. He was parish priest of the Church of Our Lady of Czestochowa from 1996 to 2013. Intriago was dismissed from his priestly functions by the Archdiocese of Guayaquil after there were complaints that Intriago sexually abused and tortured minors. Intriago told his victims that to help themselves and their families, they needed to suffer through a secret sacrifice, which he named the dynamic of sin. The Catholic Church does not approve such rituals.
